annotations.annotation_text: (Latin) By straight roads; By straight paths. This is the Blackwood family motto.[1] It is also the school motto of Belvedere College in Dublin, which Joyce attended from 1893 until 1898.[2]
sources: Gifford, Don, and Robert J. Seidman. Ulysses Annotated. University of California Press, 1988.
